title: perakanthus pauciflorus
intro: Perakanthus pauciflorus, commonly known as the Malayan cinnamon tree or Kamal, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Perakanthus pauciflorus include its antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help in managing blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antioxidant, anti-hyperlipidemic, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
